canonical_expression: insulin: beta cells
glucagon: alpha cells
somatostatin: delta cells
chromogranin A: secretory granules of every islet endocrine cell
E-cadherin: adherens junctions of all pancreatic epithelium (acinar, ductal, islet)
pan-cytokeratin: all pancreatic epithelium (ducts strongest, islets weakest)
keratin 19: ductal and centroacinar cells; absent from acinar and adult islet cells
PTPRC: every leukocyte
CD3 epsilon: T cells

CD4: helper T cells and monocytes/macrophages; leukocyte-only in pancreas

CD163: monocytes and macrophages only
PECAM1: all endothelium (blood and lymphatic); lower on platelets and leukocytes
alpha smooth muscle actin: vascular smooth muscle, pericytes, myofibroblasts, activated stellate cells
source: canonical; Barlow 2024 Table 2; Mereu 2026; owner decision 2026-10-28 (Barlow known-negative p99)

vimentin: every non-epithelial cell type
CD34: blood-vessel endothelium and interstitial fibroblasts
podoplanin: lymphatic endothelium and fibroblasts

CR1: B cells, monocytes, neutrophils, follicular dendritic cells
galectin-3: macrophages and ductal epithelium
beta-catenin: adherens junctions of epithelium and endothelium
UCHL1: neurons and islet endocrine cells (positive in 93 % of Beta cells here)
proliferation antigen: nucleus of cycling cells, any lineage

collagen IV: basement-membrane matrix, not a cell marker
